script_text: Stop everything, Aquarius — the stars are rewriting you right now. Pluto, your modern ruler, is retrograde at three degrees Aquarius in your First House of self, throwing a square at Saturn, your traditional ruler, in your Third House of words. Expect conversations to twist against you. In your Fifth House of romance, retrograde Uranus in Gemini keeps flipping love into surprises — a familiar face resurfaces, or a quirky stranger stops you mid-sentence. Your Tenth House of career is on fire: Sun square Pluto from Scorpio forces a power standoff with a boss or client — hold your ground, but document everything. Mercury is slowing in late Scorpio, one week from its retrograde station. So do not sign, send, or swear anything this week. Follow for tomorrow's reading, when Venus stations direct.
